retrievalProfile.description: A split-layout album cover featuring a top typographic header block inside a decorative frame and a bottom rectangular photograph of a musician in a forest.

recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part vertical composition with a vibrant green header section containing text enclosed in a bracketed ornamental frame, positioned above a white-bordered rectangular photograph of a man with a guitar in a sun-dappled evergreen forest.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy typographic hierarchy against a solid color field
Sharp white border separating the graphic header from the photographic footer
Contrast between flat graphic green and organic forest textures
Centrally aligned text within a decorative bracketed container
coreInvariants: Saturated green background for the top half
White rectangular frame around the photograph
Bracketed ornamental flourishes flanking the main text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician centered in the lower half, occupying roughly 40% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold artist name in the upper third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Header text to artist name to tracklist to the central figure in the photograph.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid green margins at the top and sides provide breathing room for the text block.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation green and blue against earthy browns and greens in the photo.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to green, blue, yellow, and white for the graphic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight for the primary name
Uniform stroke thickness in the display titles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and widths of the same sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and mid-century feel of the artist name.
Matches the tight, clean look of the tracklist text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split layout with a solid kelly green top half and a white-bordered rectangular photo of a man with a guitar in a pine forest in the bottom half. Include a thin white bracketed frame in the center of the green section.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of sans-serif text inside the bracketed frame: a bold yellow title, a very large cyan artist name, and a condensed yellow tracklist block.

verificationChecks: Is the green background saturated and flat?
Is the artist name the largest typographic element?
Is the photo contained within a distinct white border?
Are the ornamental brackets present on the sides of the text block?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles
The specific face of the musician
postGenerationChecks: Check for centered alignment of all text elements.
Ensure the white border around the photo is uniform.
Verify the bracketed frame is symmetrical.
Confirm the color palette remains limited to the 1960s aesthetic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-layout + Saturated Green Header + Bracketed Text Frame + White-Bordered Forest Photo
